channel.title: Daily brief - Martin Jordanovski
channel.description: AI, technology and software development news, summarised every morning. Leadership, psychology and investing on Mondays.

item.title: Daily brief, 25 Nov 2026
item.description:
Tidal to ban AI-generated music from December 9: Tidal will stop accepting fully AI-generated music on December 9 and will remove about 29 million such songs. It expects to reject roughly 80,000 to 85,000 tracks a day, and still allows tracks made with AI assistance.
Active intrusion campaign targets Check Point security management servers: An ongoing intrusion campaign is reported to be targeting Check Point security management servers. The report drew significant discussion on Hacker News.
Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after near-24-hour Outlook and Exchange outage: A nearly 24-hour Exchange Online and Outlook outage cut off email for millions of customers. Microsoft traced it to a bug that had sat on Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers, and it has declared an unusual internal 'Code Red'.
